title.narrative: Strengthening the operational and financial sustainability of the national Protected Area System

description.narrative: Strengthening the operational and financial sustainability of the national Protected Area System

sector.narrative: Structural transformation, including green, inclusive and digital transitions

condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

description.narrative: Ultimate Outcomes: 0.1 NPAS operational sustainability measured by average METT score for all PAs based on the following definitions: High (75-100), Medium (55-74), Low (<55). 0.2 NPAS financial capacity measured by Financial Sustainability Scorecard. 0.4 Population of 4 indicator species; 0.4.2 Population of Queen Conch (Strombus gigas). 0.4.2 Population of Black Bill Parrot (Amazona agilis). 0.4.4 Population of Yellow Bill Parrot (Amazona collaria). 0.5 Percentage area of living reef within 10 NPAS monitoring sites. Outcome1: 1.1 Increase in Protected Area Trust Fund (CBF) principal and annual disbursement to NPAS. 1.3 Annual government funding for PAs. 1.4 Annual non-government resources for PAs. 1.5 Local Protected Area Trust Fund 100% established and operational by 2016. 1.6 Number of Protected Areas with Business Plans that reflect NPAS standards. 1.7 Number of Protected Areas with mechanisms to generate revenue at the site level. 1.8 Extent to which operational plan for the PA system financial strategy developed (completed, partially completed, not done); . Outcome2: 2.1 Number of PAs with clearly designated lead and support entity. 2.2 Status of developing drafting instructions for umbrella PA legislation and the supporting legal framework (completed, partially completed, not done); . Outcome 3: 3.1 Increase in PA management effectiveness measured by METT scores. 3.3 Number of PAs with management plans that reflect NPAS management guideline standards. 3.4 Extent to which the M&E system for NPA management developed (completed, partially completed, not done). 3.5 Number of PAs with conservation-based economic activities. 3.6 Status of implementation of Communication Strategy for NPAS (completed, partially completed, not done).
